name: com.cone.grass
description: GPU procedural grass and meadow flowers for URP terrain. Authored placement areas and painted density, plant kinds with flower heads, geometric LOD, terrain colour matching, collider-driven bending with recovery, and optional contact shadows and motion vectors. Rendered through RenderGraph with compute-generated, indirect draws.

samples.description: A terrain meadow with flowers at grass height and a character whose collider bends the grass as it walks. WASD to walk, Shift to run, right mouse to orbit; the character walks on its own when idle.
Optional: connects saved MicroVerse mask outputs to grass placement areas and matching terrain colours. Requires MicroVerse.
